title: The McMartin Preschool Trial (1983–1990)
summary: Seven years, ~$15–16M — the longest, most expensive criminal trial in US history at the time. Allegations included satanic rituals, tunnels under the school and animal sacrifice. Result: NO convictions. Peggy McMartin Buckey acquitted of all counts Jan 18, 1990; Ray Buckey acquitted on 52 of 65 counts, rest hung/dismissed. Suggestive child-interview techniques were discredited and reshaped abuse investigations nationwide.
